trace.mapping: replace simulation UTC year with 2020; preserve month/day/hour/minute
trace.mem_formula: 5 * avg_mem; retain upstream memory unit convention

physical_and_execution.execution: nonpreemptive; release at next 15-minute boundary after declared finish; capacity check and immediate resource update for each EDF-ordered candidate; one-pass backfill
physical_and_execution.power: post-decision resource utilization held over [t,t+15min); unchanged upstream IT/HVAC formulas
physical_and_execution.deadline_completion_rule: declared finish_time <= synthetic deadline is on time; boundary resource-release time is recorded separately

environment.carbon_policy_sampling: latest source observation at or before now; no future CI
environment.weather_timezone: metadata_fixed_offset_minus_25200_seconds; matches summer America/Los_Angeles offset for these envelopes
environment.weather_sampling: corresponding UTC linear interpolation for physical model only
environment.coverage_identity_test_scope: prior manifest only; whole raw container hash verification is not Test slicing or policy evaluation

policy.calibration_rule: median of 720 historical hourly direct CI observations

stress.parent_order: SHA256 canonical(seed,task_id), stable task ID tie-break
stress.clone_features: same arrival/duration/resource demand/deadline derivation; unique suffixed ID
stress.label: synthetic same-timestamp pressure; not an independently measured high-load trace
stress.load_selection_rule: highest predeclared Train factor with all compared methods fully drained, at least one capacity-wait event, and distinct (deadline_violation_rate_observed, mean_wait_minutes_started) among the three heuristic modes; stop and report insufficient signal if none
stress.train_reset_seed_schedule: fixed stress seed 510001 at the selected factor for all episodes and all RL seeds; 510002/510003 reserved only
stress.validation_factor: same factor selected using Train only

learning.baseline: ordinary PPO-v0 mode selector; not task-level budget or Safety Shield
learning.normalization_transform: signed x/(scale+abs(x)); utilization is demand/capacity; cyclical time features in [-1,1]
learning.reward_event_rule: count first currently determined miss once per arrived task; on truncation charge arrived unfinished count plus remaining normalized resource work

termination_and_selection.training_episode: stop at own full Drain; truncate only at real environment safety_end or an explicitly recorded training cutoff
termination_and_selection.formal_group_endpoint: maximum drain time of all compared heuristics and retained candidates in that same frozen cohort; if any capped incomplete run, use safety_end and disallow equal-work superiority claims
termination_and_selection.early_drain_tail: same persistent physics integrates idle utilization using real corresponding CI/weather through common end
termination_and_selection.selection_eligibility: all arrived tasks completed, no censored tasks, miss rate <= 0.05
termination_and_selection.selection_rank: minimum common-window carbon_kg, then deadline miss rate, then seed, then checkpoint SHA256 (matching preregistered PPO config)
termination_and_selection.sla_gate_role: predeclared operational candidate screen, not a discovered natural feasibility boundary
termination_and_selection.no_eligible_candidate: report none; retain every candidate and all results; no threshold or reward retuning

enforcement_requirements: whitelist train/validation split roles and exact UTC bounds; reject test before loading or running
verify source hashes, frozen workload/environment payload hashes and expected capacity/config
verify every task arrival is inside its declared split and workload/env bounds agree
reject training a validation/test snapshot even if caller renames its label
model selection uses Validation only; data preprocessing uses declared engineering constants or Train only
no test forecasts, outcomes or observed Test normalization fitting are available to trainer/evaluator
preserve source/config/runtime/checkpoint/output hashes and original archive provenance
